textSequence: I'm a second-year biology student at Cardinal Ridge University, and I'm applying for your summer research internship in the microbiology group.

My lab experience so far comes from coursework, but I've taken it seriously. In Intro Biology my team cultured soil samples from 12 campus sites and compared what grew. I learned aseptic technique, kept a careful lab notebook, and found out how much I enjoy the slow work of getting a culture right.

Outside of class I work at the university library and help lead the Pre-Health Society. Both jobs have taught me to be reliable, to keep track of details, and to ask questions when something doesn't make sense.
I would be grateful for the chance to learn from your team this summer. Thank you for considering my application.
